notes: §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR4 states the conversion of every legal elementary move: a) an alphanumeric or alphanumeric edited receiver (alignment, space fill, the sign and a separate sign position not moved, no de-editing, P positions counted as zeros), b) a numeric or numeric edited receiver ('alignment by decimal point and any necessary zero filling takes place', de-editing of a numeric edited sender, sign rules 1 and 2, and 3: 'When the sending operand is described as being alphanumeric, data is moved as if the sending operand were described as an unsigned numeric integer'), c) an alphabetic receiver. One emitter serves every edition: MoveEmitter.ConvertSource, by the kind MoveClassifier.Kind gives the store; a character receiver goes through CharacterStore over SendingCharacters (a numeric sender de-signed), a numeric one through NumericRenderer (AlnumNum / CobolNum.FromAlphanumericSending for an alphanumeric sender, CobolEdit.DeEdit for a numeric edited one). Probes at --std 85 agree with a), b) 1 and 2, c) and with b) 3 for a literal and a data item (27 moves: SIGN SEPARATE both ways, COMP, 9PP, JUSTIFIED, alphanumeric edited onto itself, de-editing a CR item into signed, unsigned and edited receivers), and the witness runs three of them. It does NOT conform for a figurative constant of category alphanumeric (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3: 'All other figurative constants belong to the category alphanumeric'), whose string is the size of the receiver (§1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3) and which b) 3 then makes an unsigned integer: (1) a digit-only ALL literal into a noninteger numeric item is not aligned by decimal point: AllDigitFill lays the digits over the receiver's digit positions at its scale (555.55 where the same five characters as a literal or a PIC X(5) item give 555.00); (2) into a numeric edited item ConvertSource returns the repeated literal as the whole image, so no editing takes place (555555 in a ZZ9.99 item); (3) QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE or a non-digit ALL literal into a numeric item that is not usage DISPLAY (COMP, COMP-3) compiles clean and stops the run unit with NotImplementedCobolFeatureException (FigurativeToNumericImageStore's guard); the value there is undefined (§1985:VI.6.4.7) but the move is legal (GR3 e). These are the 'pre-removal' paths the code marks provisional; 2023 refuses all three shapes (COBOL0902), so only --std 85, 2002 and 2014 reach them. kb/Work PB426 read 2023 GR6 d) 3 b as the positional fill; the 1985 text has no such sentence.

next.reason: 1985 GR4: conversion 'takes place during legal elementary moves, along with any editing specified for' the receiver, with no exception for a sender and receiver that are the same item, and §1985:VI.6.4.5 makes overlap undefined only when the items 'are not defined by the same data description entry'. §2023:14.9.25.4 GR6 b) 1: when the sending and receiving operands reference the same data item, 'If the category of the operand is alphanumeric-edited or national-edited, the result of execution of the statement is undefined'. MOVE X TO X of an alphanumeric-edited X was defined (editing) in 1985 and is undefined in 2023: a result made undefined. The rest (sign, separate sign, 'P', usage conversion, signed/unsigned receivers, alphanumeric sender as an unsigned integer) recurs in GR6 a) and d); the de-editing provisions in §2023:14.9.25.4 GR5 ('De-editing takes place only when the sending operand is a numeric-edited data item'). The 31-position cap cannot alter an 18-digit 1985 receiver.
